description: The SPA fallback (static-assets contract). fixture: the built files (UTF-8 text), served at prefix with apiPrefixes added in code, behind routes (each answers 200 {"route": pattern}), APP_ENV test. Each case: the request (path as sent, before percent-decoding) and the answer: status, every header except X-Correlation-Id and Content-Length, sorted by name, the body length and its SHA-256 in lowercase hex (for HEAD, bodyLength is the Content-Length sent with no body). A server that refuses an unclean request line before the framework (Jetty: 400) is outside the vector, which runs in process.
